title: GEMSDOE — Geologic Mapping Prize Challenge
description: Evidence-backed working site for the DOE GEMS Prize Challenge on DrivenData — predicting geothermal faults in the GeoDAWN region under a distance-weighted Tversky metric, with a 19-band feature stack, a $300,000 prize pool split $50,000 initial and $250,000 final, ending 2026-12-03 at 11:59 p.m. UTC. STATUS.md at commit cf20e1b records session 23 (2026-09-22), which made it possible to generate a submission from the site itself in the browser with no install and no GPU: scripts/build_submission_payload.py encodes the adopted artifact into docs/submission_field.bin (a gems-rle-v1 uleb128 run-length stream, 532,174 bytes for 259,549 runs) with a manifest of grid, transform, EPSG, resolution, value counts, blob hash, artifact hash and 17 named checks, where --check re-derives the manifest from the raster and refuses if any pin drifted and --verify decodes the blob and compares float32 bits; docs/geotiff_writer.js is a dependency-free TIFF/ZIP writer in plain JS with real deflate, and the CLI and CI routes produce the same bytes. Session 21 closed the standing data-placement blocker in-sandbox: scripts/assemble_data_bridge.py reassembled all three official rasters from committed parts in 2.8 s with every part and whole-file sha256 verified (training_features.tif 418,912,844 B, labels.tif 425,830 B, sample_submission.tif 1,599,597 B), and scripts/prepare_data.py passed on the placed bytes (3292x3730, 19 bands, EPSG:32611, 100 m, aligned bounds, band tags present); scripts/baseline_submission.py then reproduced the committed submission.tif byte for byte (sha256 9f2577cff20d...) in about 17 minutes on 2 vCPU with no torch, and scripts/validate_submission.py passed all 8 checks on the fresh file. The scientific stance remains deliberately unhedged and unclaimed: all four block-holdout folds are committed and the memorisation-versus-transfer gap is reported as a spread rather than a point — fold 0 +0.0114, fold 1 -0.0070, fold 2 +0.0139, fold 3 +0.0093, mean +0.006904, spread 0.020935, positive in 3 of 4 — and because no fold reaches the 12 resampling units a readable block-bootstrap interval needs, the scorer itself flags every per-fold interval interval_readable false, so the honest reading is 'no clear memorisation, no clear transfer gain' with the full-grid 0.099859 (reproduced digit-for-digit on a runner) retained as the selection statistic. The pseudo-label contrast has fired twice and STATUS.md is explicit that quoting either fire alone would overstate the precision: the first gave held-out blocks 0.0806 to 0.1841 (+0.1036, P=0.999) on the new-fault-like proxy against 0.2113 to 0.1239 (-0.0874, P=0.001) on catalogue labels, and the second — same seed, same config, same partition, different runner — measured proxy +0.0677 and catalogue -0.1079, a roughly 0.036 run-to-run swing on the proxy arm of the same order as the +0.0313 union contrast itself; the two scopes also disagree in sign on the union (+0.0313 held-out against -0.0375 trained-on), which STATUS.md calls instability rather than a result. Against the paired block-bootstrap bar its own FIELD rule uses (P >= 0.95) the union contrast reaches P = 0.916 with an interval spanning zero on 8 scoreable blocks, so it is suggestive and not established, both verdicts carry shippable_evidence false, and the circularity is derived rather than asserted because the pseudo-label path is the same proxy_catalogue.tif the proxy truth is cut from. A third population is the disjoint 122,652-pixel union (60,988 + 61,664, disjointness verified at score time). STATUS.md also defuses one coincidence on purpose: the baseline's union held-out DTI of 0.197183 resembles the public leaderboard's top score of 0.1972, and the two are unrelated quantities. IRREGULARITY: the repository's own test suite fails at this head — `python3 -m pytest tests -q` gives 467 passed, 32 skipped and 1 FAILED (tests/test_site_pages.py::test_the_build_reproduces_the_committed_pages), and 32 of the skips are environment-gated rather than the 1 STATUS.md reports (IRR-102). The next-session ordering stands at item 8 (the only unbiased signal: enroll and first upload, against a bar of 0.2854 as of 2026-09-21), then 3, then 6, then firing the pseudo-label workflow for folds 1-3 so the pool crosses 12 units before the runner artifacts expire around 2026-10-03.
